name: AccountingEntry
summary: Records one amount and what it is for, so that money is classified by the entries made about it rather than by the field it happens to sit in.

roles.name: AccountingEntry
roles.summary: One record of an amount, in the ledger sense. It records money coming in and money going out, and also movements that hand over no money at all, such as a transfer — which is why it is a classification of money and not a payment.

roles.name: Amount
roles.summary: What the entry is for, as a quantity with its unit. It need not be money: hours worked and kilowatt hours are accounted for by the same patterns.

roles.name: WhenBooked
roles.summary: When the entry was made, as against when the event it answers occurred. The two differ, and an accounting period is closed on the booking date.

roles.name: Descriptor
roles.summary: What kind of entry this is — the project, the cost type, the classification the entry carries. It is what an account later gathers entries by.
